later_or_conflicting_evidence.meeting_title: Kobi <> Cedrick - Wagertech Deal and CMS Integration Walkthrough
later_or_conflicting_evidence.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: we're going to turn this into a child object that is dated so we are able to track those changes. … Um and then there'll be on whether this is required before activation or not. … there should be no overlaps in the dates

Kobi Kunasekaran: Um and from our conversation, we said that this information um one it needs to get stamped on the signup. So when you report on a sign up, you can see what the commercial terms was at the time the sign up first bet was completed.

what_differs: The 2026-09-30 client sync decided: a custom object under the Deal, only one active term per period with an error on overlap, a 'manage commercial term' path to correct a term or create a new one, CPA and payout model changes create a new term, sign-ups from a new term's start date tie to it, and per-field tracking (for example deposit range) is deferred. WAGR-462 (last written 2026-09-25) states none of these rules, and no Commercial Terms build stories exist in Jira.
suggested_action: Add the 2026-09-30 rules to WAGR-462 as acceptance criteria and create the build stories (Kobi drafted them per L2728). Record that per-field tracking is deferred.
